title: Separate candidate reservation from identity and make releases append-only
migration_impact: Represent C32 as a reserved candidate floor while 3.2.5 is planned, assign evidence-bearing candidate_id only at source or package freeze, and model later release facts as append-only events and post-publication qualifications over immutable release identity.
release_note_impact: Generated views and maintainer runbooks must distinguish planned reservation, exact candidate, immutable publication identity, later qualification, and current status.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: apply before C32 source freeze; any package change after the first build increments the candidate
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: use the same reservation/event model for P12, conditional 2.5.5, and 2.6 without rewriting P11 history

terminal_disposition: Implemented by the C32 and lower-wave candidate reservation, append-only release records, closures, freezes, and immutable publication identities.
